title: Trader Joe’s
slugLine: An Expo Counter and seating area that brings healthy, affordable hot food to Trader Joe’s stores.

research.problem: Customers who want ==hot, ready-made food== have no options at Trader Joe’s, **while Costco, PCC and Whole Foods all offer fresh hot-food counters**.

stakeholders.name: Busy, health-conscious shoppers
stakeholders.note: Urban, mostly plant-based, prefer shopping in store

stakeholders.name: Local farmers
stakeholders.note: Produce sourced locally, with a share of sales

stakeholders.name: Local artists
stakeholders.note: Decorate containers and bags for each region

stakeholders.name: Chefs
stakeholders.note: Corporate chefs for national menus, local and guest chefs in store

painPoints.label: Too busy to cook
painPoints.detail: She is too busy to prepare meals but still wants to eat healthy.

painPoints.label: Few hot options
painPoints.detail: Limited hot-meal options push her toward delivery or unhealthy food.

painPoints.label: Single-use packaging
painPoints.detail: She dislikes single-use packaging and looks for sustainable alternatives.

painPoints.label: Frozen fatigue
painPoints.detail: She gets bored with frozen meals and wants more variety.

rows.target: 10% more new customers across stores nationally
Sell 20% more products by the end of the year
65% of users keep eating at the hot bar
$500,000 in the first quarter across the first 12 stores
50,000 social media shares and 200,000 likes by the end of the three-month campaign

insights.insight: Ready meals are a growing market
insights.evidence: The North American ready-meals market is expected to reach about $89.9B by 2027, growing 5.3% a year.
69% of consumers are more likely to buy a food product after sampling it in store, and 86% have bought a product after trying a sample.

insights.insight: Trader Joe’s wins in the store
insights.evidence: Costco and Whole Foods (since acquired by Amazon) prioritize online sales. Trader Joe’s model is built on its in-store experience, which a hot bar and free samples would deepen.

insights.insight: The brand already carries the idea
insights.evidence: Shoppers see Trader Joe’s as healthier and affordable, like its frozen ready meals, and know it for unique private-label products the hot bar can showcase.

roadmap.what: Modular kitchens and seating in 12 new stores
Corporate chefs set national menus, local chefs cook in store
Local farms for produce, local artists for custom containers and bags
Modular kitchens in every store after the trial period

design.lead: An Expo Counter and seating area in each store serves healthy, affordable hot food in reusable containers decorated by local artists, with free samples of seasonal items to draw shoppers in.

blocks.title: Products and services
items: Reusable containers decorated by local artists
Custom bags that mark hot-food items and build recognition
Quick bites and free food samples
Indoor or outdoor seating, depending on the location

clauses.label: Hot meals
clauses.text: convenient, quick access to ready-made meals

clauses.label: High-quality produce
clauses.text: sourced directly from ethical, well-maintained farms

clauses.label: Affordability
clauses.text: diverse healthy choices that follow Trader Joe’s business model

clauses.label: Cozy vibe
clauses.text: a curated hot bar and seating design that draws customers in

blocks.title: Revenue model
items: Samples and brand ambassadors give shoppers a reason to try it
A loss leader on one or two popular items leads shoppers into the rest, as at Costco

blocks.title: Impact models
items: A percentage of Expo sales goes to local farmers
Bottle and food-container returns for sustainability
Local artists decorate containers for each store

results.lead: The launch campaign runs for one quarter in the first 12 stores, aiming for ==$500,000 in Expo revenue== and 10% more new customers nationally.

blocks.title: Campaign touchpoints
items: An exclusive release to the first 12 stores
Social: “You already love our products, but now you can get them fresh at the hot bar”
Videos on Trader Joe’s Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, with local brand ambassadors filming mukbang videos at the counter
In store: free samples at the counter, signs to the seating area, and staff who engage shoppers

blocks.title: Risks
items: A negative impact on Trader Joe’s brand and market presence
Shoppers may not try the Expo, leading to monetary and spatial losses
